name: promotion-provider
title: Promotion provider
description: Loads and sanitises promotions, keeps time to the exact start and end, routes dismissals to per-scope stores, applies frequency windows and a daily interruption budget, waits for engagement without interrupting, runs plugins such as exit intent, and reports impressions, clicks, copies, reveals and dismissals.
docs: Pass your router's pathname and, for client-side navigation, your Link as `linkComponent`. A `{ load }` source runs once per mount; change `sourceKey` to reload. Add behaviour with `plugins={[exitIntent()]}` (keep the array stable). Route dismissals with `storage={composeStores({ cookie: cookieDismissalStore(), account })}`. Set `locale` to pick record translations and pass a `labels` pack. Theme the highlight tone with `--promo-highlight` and `--promo-highlight-foreground`.
